svg.text: The same piece of work, reported twice.
One of these you can act on. Both are equally true.
BEFORE
I've implemented the low-stock alerting feature.
Added a `threshold` column to `inventory_items`
via a new Prisma migration, created
`checkLowStock()` in src/lib/inventory/alerts.ts,
and wired it to a Vercel Cron job. Also
refactored `InventoryTable` and added an RLS
policy scoping reads to `store_id`.
Tests pass.
← you have no way to check this
You'll need to run the migration and set
CRON_SECRET. Let me know if you want Resend
or SendGrid.
Every word is true.
Nothing in it is checkable, actionable,
or answerable by someone who can't read code.
AFTER
Done
• Every item on the count sheet now has a
"minimum." When a store drops below it,
the item turns red.
(I watched this work: set milk powder to 10
for Puebla, entered a count of 6, it turned red.)
